new-level.label: Taking stairs to depth 31
new-level.explanation: The Borg holds an object-detection stamp for panel 0 from the previous level. On a depth change the other per-panel flags (walls, traps, doors, evil) are cleared but the object flag is not: the new level's panel still counts as detected and the Borg skips casting detect objects there. The correction clears it with the others; the wall flag is the witness that the pass ran.

native-c/detectcarry-219: starting...
SETUPSTEP profile
SETUP olddepth=30 curdepth=31 panels=1,1
SETUP seed=1000 class=Warrior level=1 hp=20/20
  detection_flags_cleared_on_new_level  MODE new-level
STATE obj=1 wall=0
OUTCOME obj_cleared=0 wall_cleared=1
Failed
    native-c/detectcarry-219:122: requirement 'obj == 0' failed

same-level.label: Control: no depth change
same-level.explanation: With the depth unchanged nothing is cleared in either version. The complete logs are byte-identical.
